sports.hint: Spanish tennis phenom is the defending champion and confirmed to return for the final major of the year, recovering from a wrist injury.

pop_culture.hint: Beloved alternative folk singer-songwriter Bridgers releases a new album after more than six years.

tech_science.hint: NASA successfully tested a system allowing satellites to navigate without GPS by using other spacecraft and debris as landmarks in orbit.
